## Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] Component meets WCAG AAA contrast requirements (7:1 for normal text)
- [ ] Full keyboard navigation support (Tab, Enter, Escape, Arrow keys)
- [ ] Proper ARIA labels and semantic HTML/GTK4 structure
- [ ] Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (no animations when enabled)
- [ ] Works with screen readers (Orca, etc.)
- [ ] Verified with accessibility testing tools

## Documentation

- [ ] README.md updated (if necessary)
- [ ] API documentation added/updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] Code comments added where necessary
- [ ] Examples provided (if applicable)

## Code Quality

- [ ] Code follows Rust conventions and project style
- [ ] No clippy warnings (`cargo clippy`)
- [ ] Code is properly formatted (`cargo fmt`)
- [ ] Variable names are clear and descriptive
- [ ] Functions are small and focused
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies added
